name: v0.3.33 — Profile redesigned as vertical-scroll card list
releaseNotes:
• Profile screen redesigned to match the simple vertical-scroll pattern. Horizontal-scroll Guac-AI strip + 2-column pill grid replaced with single-column card rows grouped into clear sections:
  → My Activity (Worth It · GuacScore · GuacWizard)
  → Money (Reports · Returns · Rewards)
  → Shop (Stores · Stash · Steals)
  → Mail & retailers (Connections · Inbox)
  → Settings (biometric · mailbox · Security · Privacy)
• Stores added to Profile (was previously only in the Menu long-press popover).
• Debug log + Report a problem pills removed from everyday Profile chrome (still reachable via app-lock screen + crash flows).
• Duplicate Inbox pill removed.
